subject: error: libnetcdf.so.6: cannot open shared object file

messages.author: 33fe3608622d7c76
messages.subject: error: libnetcdf.so.6: cannot open shared object file
parts:
Hi,

I've been using Shiny for a while now and its been working great. However, this past weekend I tried to access my website and got this error message:

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : unable to load shared object '/home/climatetool/R/library/ncdf/libs/ncdf.so': libnetcdf.so.6: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory Error: package/namespace load failed for ‘ncdf’ Execution halted

The last time I tried to get to the website before this weekend was on Thursday (Oct. 9) and had no issues. Then a few days later it stopped working. I tried to install the ncdf package again but when I do that I get this error message:

ERROR: configuration failed for package ‘ncdf’
* removing ‘/home/climatetool/R/library/ncdf’
* restoring previous ‘/home/climatetool/R/library/ncdf’
Warning in install.packages :
  installation of package ‘ncdf’ had non-zero exit status

I'm wondering if there was some kind of update that went on with the server that is preventing me from being able to install the ncdf package anymore. Thanks in advance for your help.

Sarah

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: error: libnetcdf.so.6: cannot open shared object file
parts:
Sarah,

Can you be more specific about how you are running your Shiny application. 

- Is your application on spark or glimmer servers (or shinyapps.io)? What URL?
- Are you running your own instance of Shiny Server? In that case please provide the following information:
+ Version of Shiny Server (shiny-server --version)
+ The linux distribution your Shiny Server is running on


Thanks,
Fereshteh

Best,
Fereshteh
